fusions.name: Hoof Stamp
fusions.desc: Stamps the haft down, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and slowing each by 15% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Dug-In Drive
fusions.desc: Digs in and drives the fork home, dealing 28 damage and leaving the target 12% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Will Not Be Moved
fusions.desc: Plants the haft: for 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Ground Held
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 6% of your maximum health per stack before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
